description:
The annual Duluth Dylan Fest celebrates Bob Dylan in the city of his birth
Support The Current: https://support.mpr.org/youtube or hit the Thanks button

Duluth, Minnesota, is the birthplace of Bob Dylan — and the city knows how to celebrate its native son in a way where everyone is welcome to participate. The annual Duluth Dylan Fest (which runs May 17 to 24 this year) showcases Duluth’s poets, writers and musicians while highlighting the music of one of its most prolific artists: the man born Robert Zimmerman in Duluth on May 24, 1941. but known the world over as Bob Dylan. From jam sessions to lectures to concerts and a singer-songwriter contest, Duluth Dylan Fest is a celebration with a distinct northern Minnesota flavor.

Here is an inside look at Duluth Dylan Fest through the eyes of the people who help put it together or simply take part in its events.
